fact: In Guelma wilaya, a source at the land conservation said the matching of the digital database with the land book is due to finish by the end of 2026, with digitisation at 94% in Bouchegouf, 80% in two other conservations and 60% in the main one, rural cadastre complete and urban cadastre about 98%.
title: Guelma : Cadastre et conservation foncière accélèrent leur mue numérique
